body: Three specific concerns. (1) The spec's central factual claim — that OpenNeuro ds001770 is a 'Sensory Deprivation Study' with n=24 subjects scanned pre and post a '1-hour dark/quiet' deprivation — is asserted as 'confirmed' but no BIDS-structure evidence, task labels, or phenotype documentation is cited. The entire pipeline depends on this dataset containing paired pre/post deprivation resting-state runs; the edge-case handling in line 63 implicitly concedes the labels may not exist. The kind of evidence demanded here is a dataset inventory (task entities, subject count with complete pairs) before the design is fixed. (2) FR-006 conflates two different error controls: FDR correction controls the false discovery rate, not the family-wise error rate, yet the requirement demands 'ensuring family-wise error rate is controlled.' As written it is internally inconsistent and would be satisfied by neither method unambiguously. (3) The project title promises 'Simulated Sensory Deprivation,' but every user story, requirement, and assumption concerns analysis of existing real deprivation scans — no simulation of any kind appears in the spec. Either the title or the methodology is misdescribed.
